title: document-intelligence.v1 request metadata
description: Frozen request-metadata grammar shared by POST /v1/parse (JSON string in the multipart `metadata` field), POST /v1/extract and POST /v1/embed (inlined into the JSON body next to `payload`/`projection`). Mirrors RequestMetadata.parse in src/document_intelligence/contracts.py: unknown keys and missing required keys fail closed with INVALID_REQUEST. `mediaType` is required only for /v1/parse; `languageHint` values outside the admitted language catalog fail with UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE; `operationGeneration` must equal the X-Operation-Generation header when both are present.

operationGeneration.description: Optional caller-supplied cancellation token. When the X-Operation-Generation header is also present, the two values must be identical.

mediaType.description: Required by /v1/parse; the admitted set is capability-driven (default catalog: application/pdf, image/png, image/jpeg). Optional and advisory on /v1/extract and /v1/embed.

languageHint.description: Optional canonical lowercase language tag. Rejected with UNSUPPORTED_LANGUAGE when not in the admitted language catalog (default: en, ne).

timeoutMs.description: Upper bound is the configured limit (default max_operation_timeout_ms = 120000).

limits.description: String-keyed map of request-scoped integer limits. Unknown keys are tolerated; values must be JSON integers.
